title: vehicle_telemetry_ping
description:
Buoc 2 cua ke hoach mock telemetry (docs/telemetry-research.md). Hop dong NHAP, tong hop tu quan sat truc tiep app Xanh SM (khach), Xanh SM Driver, V-Green va cau truc telemetry cua du an mo vinfast-connected-car - KHONG phai API that cua VinFast/GSM (ho khong cong khai spec). Muc dich: du de vá lai schemas/l1/gps_ping.schema.json cua GSM_SIMULATOR (dang danh dau 'TBC-voi-GSM').

PHAT HIEN QUAN TRONG: he thong that dung lat/lng + heading + speed tho (tu GPS dien thoai hoac TCU xe), KHONG phai o H3. Lop H3 trong 13 bang GSM_SIMULATOR (public_driver_hex_tracking) la MOT TANG TONG HOP/AN DANH tren telemetry tho, khong phai dinh dang goc he thong nhan. Day la ly do tan suat ban ghi trong public_driver_hex_tracking khong deu (33-74s) - no chi ghi lai MOI LAN DOI O HEX, khong phai moi lan ping (3-5s theo quan sat UI).

trip_id.description: null neu dang o trang thai cho cuoc (chua ghep)

source_device.description: Xe may dien (Feliz S/Evo200/Klara S) khong co TCU rieng - dinh vi lay tu dien thoai tai xe qua app Xanh SM Driver. Xe hoi VinFast (VF 5/VF e34/VF 8) co TCU rieng, giau tren xe, tach biet voi dien thoai.

current_hex_h3_res9.description: Suy tu lat/lng o tang xu ly (khong phai truong goc tu thiet bi) - de tuong thich nguoc voi cac detector Tier A dang dung H3.

vin.description: 17 ky tu ISO - bat buoc khac null khi source_device='vehicle_tcu_car', luon null voi xe may (xe may khong co so khung dang VIN oto).

gear.description: CHI CO O XE HOI (CAN-bus) - xe may dien khong co hop so/gear. Tin hieu cot loi cho F5/cuoc ao: bam 'bat dau chuyen' nhung gear != 'D' va odometer dung yen.

odometer_km.description: CHI CO O XE HOI (doc tu CAN-bus). Xe may khong co odometer dien tu dang nay trong pham vi quan sat duoc.

battery_level_pct.description: CO O CA HAI loai xe - da sua so voi ban nhap dau (Buoc 2 ghi nham la 'chi xe hoi'). Xe may dien MOI la doi tuong chinh cua doi pin V-Green (Feliz S/Evo200/Klara S) - pin nhay tu thap len ~95-100% trong 120-300s khi dung tai tu, KHAC voi duong cong sac tu tu cua o to. Nguon so lieu khac nhau theo source_device: xe may doc tu app/BLE cua pack pin, xe hoi doc tu BMS qua TCU.

charging_status.description: CO O CA HAI loai xe. Voi xe may, 'CHARGING' thuc chat la trang thai dang doi pin tai tu (khong sac tai cho, chi hoan doi pin) - phan biet voi xe hoi co the sac cham that su.

seat_occupancy.description: Chi co o xe hoi. Tin hieu cot loi cho F1 (cho khach khong tao cuoc) va ep huy: ghe co nguoi ngoi nhung khong co trip_id dang active.

phone_connectivity_lost.description: true khi ping nay den tu vehicle_tcu (xe van online qua modem rieng cua xe) TRONG LUC dien thoai tai xe duoc ghi nhan mat ket noi/tat dinh vi - bang chung manh cho 'ngat dinh vi giua chuyen' vi xe van stream duoc du lieu qua kenh khac dien thoai.
